topic: What link budget trade-offs exist when balancing data rate and reliability in adverse weather for satellite backhaul links?
consensus_response: In adverse weather, satellite backhaul links face increased path loss and signal attenuation. This necessitates a careful balance between data rate and reliability.  Higher data rates require increased power and antenna gain, leading to higher interference and path loss.  Advanced coding schemes and adaptive modulation are crucial to maintain reliability under these conditions.  Network management plays a vital role in dynamically adjusting power levels and coding schemes to maintain both high data rates and consistent reliability.
reference_context: Satellite backhaul links experience challenges in adverse weather due to increased path loss and signal attenuation.  This requires a trade-off between data rate and reliability.
